interface.title: CYRANO — Flow Cytometry Analysis Orchestrator
interface.stage_of_work: Data intake and quality control of raw acquisition files, before gating or deeper analysis
interface.what_it_is_for: Reading FCS files to show event counts, channels, signal types and the plate well taken from each filename, comparing two runs side by side, and making a per-well event-count heatmap for a 96-well plate.

data.note: The only test file was flow-cytometry-12ch.fcs (5785 events; channels Time, FSC, SSC, GFP, mCherry, Alexa Fluor™ 405; signal types A/H/W). Its name has no '_<well>' ending, so Well reads 'None'. The browser cannot rename files, so a populated plate heatmap could not be made.
